\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:RU-R135-first-pass-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to draw and to travel.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item last, famous, important, interesting, boring
  \item cheerful, kind, angry; wicked, serious, right
  \item wrong, ready, dangerous, wet, dry
  \item soft, hard, round, wide, narrow
  \item bitter, salty, heavy, thin, fat
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Last? (\textbf{\ru{последний}}.) Famous? (\textbf{\ru{известный}}.) Important? (\textbf{\ru{важный}}.) Interesting? (\textbf{\ru{интересный}}.) Boring? (\textbf{\ru{скучный}}.) Cheerful? (\textbf{\ru{весёлый}}.) Kind? (\textbf{\ru{добрый}}.) Angry; wicked? (\textbf{\ru{злой}}.) Serious? (\textbf{\ru{серьёзный}}.) Right? (\textbf{\ru{правильный}}.) Wrong? (\textbf{\ru{неправильный}}.) Ready? (\textbf{\ru{готовый}}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{\ru{опасный}}.) Wet? (\textbf{\ru{мокрый}}.) Dry? (\textbf{\ru{сухой}}.) Soft? (\textbf{\ru{мягкий}}.) Hard? (\textbf{\ru{твёрдый}}.) Round? (\textbf{\ru{круглый}}.) Wide? (\textbf{\ru{широкий}}.) Narrow? (\textbf{\ru{узкий}}.) Bitter? (\textbf{\ru{горький}}.) Salty? (\textbf{\ru{солёный}}.) Heavy? (\textbf{\ru{тяжёлый}}.) Thin? (\textbf{\ru{худой}}.) Fat? (\textbf{\ru{толстый}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:RU-R135-second-pass-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to begin and to visit.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to begin, to visit, to put, to believe, to drive
  \item to get dressed, to wash, to get up, to sit down, to fall
  \item to go up, to go down, to stay, to rent; to take off, to repair
  \item to tell, to go for a walk, to tidy up, to find, to look for
  \item to lose, to win, to look, to draw, to travel
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To begin? (\textbf{\ru{начинать}}.) To visit? (\textbf{\ru{посещать}}.) To put? (\textbf{\ru{класть}}.) To believe? (\textbf{\ru{верить}}.) To drive? (\textbf{\ru{водить}}.) To get dressed? (\textbf{\ru{одеваться}}.) To wash? (\textbf{\ru{умываться}}.) To get up? (\textbf{\ru{вставать}}.) To sit down? (\textbf{\ru{садиться}}.) To fall? (\textbf{\ru{падать}}.) To go up? (\textbf{\ru{подниматься}}.) To go down? (\textbf{\ru{спускаться}}.) To stay? (\textbf{\ru{оставаться}}.) To rent; to take off? (\textbf{\ru{снимать}}.) To repair? (\textbf{\ru{чинить}}.) To tell? (\textbf{\ru{рассказывать}}.) To go for a walk? (\textbf{\ru{гулять}}.) To tidy up? (\textbf{\ru{убирать}}.) To find? (\textbf{\ru{находить}}.) To look for? (\textbf{\ru{искать}}.) To lose? (\textbf{\ru{терять}}.) To win? (\textbf{\ru{выигрывать}}.) To look? (\textbf{\ru{смотреть}}.) To draw? (\textbf{\ru{рисовать}}.) To travel? (\textbf{\ru{путешествовать}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
